_comment: The agent table (plan 019 §3.2): kind -> binary -> title, for the six agents
the `shed roost-provider` menu can start in a roost tab.
NOT a roost vector — see this directory's README, section 'shed's own
two-language goldens'. This file is shed's, and it may be edited; the
no-semantic-edits rule applies to the vendored vectors around it.
Asserted from three places, which is the whole point:
Order is the PROVIDER's display order — `claude codex cursor-agent
opencode gx grok`, pinned twice by §3.2 (the probe's `command -v` list and
the 'no agents found' subtitle). It differs from `roost_capabilities().kinds`,
which orders cursor and opencode the other way round; the Rust test compares
those as sets, never as sequences.
